text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Big Brother! Rice... Rice is...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "...Big Sis! Rice, Rice is...!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice did it...! Even Rice was able to do 
it...!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Rice-san.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyawa! Bourbon-san!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah. Um, er, this time Rice...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Yes, she has indeed 'caught up.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, it was incomprehensible to 
me. When every single time, you kept 
saying that you'd 'catch up.'"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In a race, only two things exist: victory, 
or defeat.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The concept of "catching up" does not 
exist. However—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I am so frustrated. Frustrated 
that I couldn't claim this Kikuka Sho. 
That I couldn't win."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...That you've caught up to me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Can you hear it, Rice-san?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaaah------!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That was an amazing race! Bourbon! Rice-!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
As expected of this year's stars! We're 
looking forward to seeing you two next 
year as well!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...No way. Rice is getting applause 
too... not just Bourbon-san?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-But... Rice only made it this far by 
chasing after Bourbon-san...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No. The crowd recognizes it. That she is a 
winner worthy of this year's Classics.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I agree with them. ...Therefore, I make 
this declaration."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Next time, I won't lose to you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ――As "rivals."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Ri... vals.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san. Will you accept a challenge from 
me?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...! R-Rice is...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice doesn't want to lose either! I 
will win against Bourbon-san... next time 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Rice Shower's voice resonated through the 
air. It was a loud, powerful declaration, 
heard by those beside her and throughout 
the entire venue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...So that her talent can blossom even 
further. I consider candidate races she 
should choose next as a stayer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a starting point for everything, 
preparations for the Nikkei Sho got 
underway.
